Endometrial hyperplasia without atypia is the most common benign cause of PMB, especially in women with unopposed estrogen exposure or obesity—hence highest confidence (0.82). Cervical adenocarcinoma is rarer than squamous cell carcinoma but increasingly recognized as a source of PMB, particularly because it may arise in the endocervix and evade routine speculum exam—thus lower but non-negligible confidence (0.63).
